svg.title: Eight weeks, one page, one deployable unit
svg.desc: A single-page hand-drawn architecture. A deploy lane across the top runs 5 percent canary, an eval gate, 25 percent, another gate and 100 percent, with red rollback arcs and a note that 3 of 14 rollouts stopped at a gate. The main flow runs from user or alert through an input guardrail costing 180 milliseconds, into an agent graph of six nodes with one cycle, then output checks for PII and groundedness, to the response. Beneath the graph sit pgvector hybrid RAG at recall@5 0.91 and Postgres checkpoints and audit log; to the right an MCP panel splits READ tools from three approval-gated WRITE verbs across a red trust boundary with a human at it. A dashed telemetry rail feeds OTel into Langfuse and an eval suite of 120 cases with judge kappa 0.71, which is the deploy gate. A heavy box at the top right holds five cards - code, prompts v8, pinned model, retrieval config and eval suite - that version together.
svg.text: Eight weeks, one page, one deployable unit
ONE deployable unit - these version TOGETHER
a human sees the resolved arguments
and the gate on the deploy lane is this suite
engineer-days a month. It is what
...and the loop starts again on Monday
